source_revision: Shopify Admin GraphQL 2026-10; assignments-v1; records-v3; questions-v9; query-cost-v1
identity_rule: Stable keyed connection-scoped fulfillment-order line identity; group updatedAt revision; immutable verified shop. Same-revision changed content is quarantined.
coverage_rule: Bounded per-order accessible member cohort at an exact cutoff. Always incomplete for actual reservations and policy; no global population or event-history claim.

retention.basis: No live store grant or merchant retention authorization is available. Synthetic evidence covers encrypted originals, monotone source/class retention, audited disposal, guarded older-backup reconciliation and interrupted key rotation. These local proofs do not establish provider permission, full operational acceptance or independent certification.

allocation_id.rule: assignments-v1 keyed connection identity from FulfillmentOrderLineItem.id
allocation_id.normalization: Stable UUID; explicit provider identity only, no name or text matching.
allocation_id.missing_behavior: Missing required link invalidates the order cohort and creates review; no fabricated link.

order_id.rule: assignments-v1 keyed connection identity from Order.id
order_id.normalization: Stable UUID; explicit provider identity only, no name or text matching.
order_id.missing_behavior: Missing required link invalidates the order cohort and creates review; no fabricated link.

line_id.rule: assignments-v1 keyed connection identity from FulfillmentOrderLineItem.lineItem.id
line_id.normalization: Stable UUID; explicit provider identity only, no name or text matching.
line_id.missing_behavior: Missing required link invalidates the order cohort and creates review; no fabricated link.

item_id.rule: assignments-v1 keyed connection identity from FulfillmentOrderLineItem.inventoryItemId
item_id.normalization: Stable UUID; explicit provider identity only, no name or text matching.
item_id.missing_behavior: Missing required link invalidates the order cohort and creates review; no fabricated link.

location_id.normalization: Stable UUID; explicit provider identity only, no name or text matching.
location_id.missing_behavior: Missing required link invalidates the order cohort and creates review; no fabricated link.

quantity.normalization: Exact integer string; must be nonnegative and no greater than totalQuantity.
quantity.missing_behavior: Invalid/null/negative/contradictory input cannot become zero or complete coverage.

unit.rule: assignments-v1: integer shipping line count is piece
unit.normalization: No conversion to weight, volume or length.
unit.missing_behavior: Other unit semantics require supplemental input.

status.rule: assignments-v1: CLOSED/CANCELLED or remainingQuantity=0 => released assignment; otherwise active derived plan
status.normalization: Source/fact only; neither actual reservation nor physical stock release is implied.
status.missing_behavior: Unsupported source status rejects the page; no default state.

policy_version.reason: Shopify assignment resources do not provide the owner-selected reservation/priority policy used by Blackbox.
policy_version.normalization: No provider-generated assignment is presented as an owner policy.
policy_version.missing_behavior: Policy-dependent answers require explicit supplemental owner policy; reservation_basis remains unknown.

evidence_id.rule: Shared ingest persists encrypted raw order cohort and binds generated evidence UUID before journal commit.
evidence_id.normalization: Tenant-scoped evidence foreign key; no personal fields requested.
evidence_id.missing_behavior: Unavailable or expired evidence is returned as unavailable, never reconstructed as original.

event_rules.rule: No observed physical reservation event inferred from assignment snapshots.
event_rules.unsupported_reason: The source supplies assignment plans, not observed reservation/release effects.

event_rules.rule: No observed physical reservation event inferred from assignment snapshots.
event_rules.unsupported_reason: The source supplies assignment plans, not observed reservation/release effects.

event_rules.rule: Versioned assignment assertion with basis derived_plan. Exact membership cohort controls current query inclusion; no physical reservation or movement.

synchronization.initial_import: Immutable date selection and selected older open/related context; nested groups and line pages complete before committing an order cohort.
synchronization.cursor: Fenced durable outer order cursor; stable updatedAt across nested reads; repeated cursors and bounds fail explicitly. Explicit requested-cost rejection reduces only connection pages without changing the fixed cursor; at most eight attempts under the original deadline.
synchronization.reconciliation: Six-hour bounded re-enumeration of selected accessible orders. Omitted assignments leave current answers through cohort membership; no inferred physical release.
synchronization.deduplication: Connection-scoped line identity plus group updatedAt; unchanged revision is idempotent, changed content conflicts.
synchronization.freshness: Every page rechecks shop and grant categories; loss of any originally used fulfillment scope category requires reauthorization.

local_standalone.schedule: Default incremental 120 seconds plus 0–10% jitter; reconciliation every six hours.
local_standalone.history_limit: At most 50000 orders, 200 groups/order, 500 lines/group, 10000 lines/page, 248 shipping assignments/order, 2 MiB response; incomplete accessible snapshot only.
local_standalone.authentication: Existing encrypted Shopify token or permitted client credentials; order and fulfillment-order grants required. Marketplace-only fulfillment grants unsupported.
local_standalone.recovery: Durable outer cursor, provider revision idempotence, bounded retries, original-input review retry, journal reconstruction after process restart.
local_standalone.limitations: No actual reservations, allocation policy or complete provider scope; non-atomic reads; nested updates may await reconciliation; no live proof.
local_standalone.reason: Local outbound assignment facts retain explicit supplemental-data requirements.

local_gateway.schedule: No gateway/server scheduling in the pilot.
local_gateway.history_limit: No history transport in this mode.
local_gateway.authentication: No public callback, gateway credential or public binding is provisioned.
local_gateway.recovery: No mode runtime to recover; use local_standalone.
local_gateway.limitations: Deferred by baseline-v14 local pilot scope.
local_gateway.reason: Explicit owner-approved P0–P4 scope excludes gateway and public-server implementation.

public_server.schedule: No gateway/server scheduling in the pilot.
public_server.history_limit: No history transport in this mode.
public_server.authentication: No public callback, gateway credential or public binding is provisioned.
public_server.recovery: No mode runtime to recover; use local_standalone.
public_server.limitations: Deferred by baseline-v14 local pilot scope.
public_server.reason: Explicit owner-approved P0–P4 scope excludes gateway and public-server implementation.

import_readiness.time_selection: Shared immutable timezone-aware 30-day/calendar/custom/from-now plan and exact fixed cutoff.
import_readiness.historical_availability: Current accessible assignment snapshots; no intermediate event history or historical opening proof.
import_readiness.open_and_related_records: Explicitly selected older accessible open context; any declined older assignment drops the entire order quantity cohort.
import_readiness.opening_state: No historical stock/reservation opening inferred. Strict decline retains only minimal header and marker without quantities.
import_readiness.progress_accounting: One order cohort per logical object, durable committed/duplicate/quarantined counts; no invented percentages.
import_readiness.readiness_rules: Always reservation_basis gap and accessible_subset_only limitation. Cohort membership retires omitted assignments without declaring reservation completeness.
import_readiness.health_rules: Per-page grant category validation, fenced credential revision and unresolved review keep health honest.
import_readiness.history_expansion: New wider immutable plan; stable revisions replay idempotently; independent incremental/reconciliation chain.
import_readiness.data_handling: Only order/group/line/item/location identifiers, counts, status and timestamps; no names/addresses. Encrypted retained input and original-plan retry; full retention/rotation certification remains open.
